column1: # Which endpoints exist, which carry a model, and which the route covers.
# Inventory read from the LIVE vLLM: kubectl exec ... curl localhost:8000/openapi.json
# on vllm/vllm-openai-cpu:v0.19.0 serving a chat model. The set is TASK DEPENDENT:
# an embedding or reranker model exposes /v1/embeddings, /pooling, /score, /rerank,
# /classify, which are absent here. So the union across model types is larger than
# "model-in-body" is the only class the model-routing rule can serve: the gateway
# has nothing else to match on. "stateful-id" requests name a prior response, not a
# model, so they cannot be model-routed at all. "no-model" needs no per-model match.
# 11 of 23 operations carry a model. The route covers 4 of them.
